distinctive_insight: Accepted statements leave scoped evidence and inference effects for subsequent complete source blocks; project loading and executable extraction participate in the same checked workflow with distinct owners.

contract_review.shared_contract: Complete input domains and guards are mandatory; return carriers bound values and are distinct from fn_range.

Field WD needs the definition-owned view; quantified laws may be reused when matching succeeds; instance release materializes field/tuple/law facts; publishing rules is not implicit opening or guaranteed goal discovery.
contract_review.editorial_change: Qualify the old blanket release wording to distinguish published individual-law verification from full-package materialization.

contract_review.shared_contract: Successful supported body definitions publish their parameterized facts with guards; temporary assumptions/proof intermediates remain local and trusted bodies retain their trust boundary.
A fact seed is verified before store/infer; explicitly assumed seeds are identified as such. Storage/inference does not run arbitrary goal search.

Cold imports run dependency files and retain module/file owners; eligible cache hits restore completed knowledge and strict mode replays source. Tokenization precedes the source block loop; parse+exec is transactional per block and a soft miss does not stop later blocks.
